timeline.title: Building Collapse in Nairobi Leaves Rubble and Rescue Efforts Underway
timeline.summary: A multi-storey building under construction collapsed in Nairobi on October 23, resulting in a significant pile of rubble. Red Cross workers and excavators are currently on the scene, searching for individuals who may be trapped beneath the debris. Concerns regarding safety have been raised following the incident.
key_facts: Multi-storey building under construction collapsed in Nairobi.
Rescue efforts are ongoing with Red Cross involvement.
Several people are feared trapped under the rubble.
